description: This file defines the COBExecutionListenerRunner class, which implements JobExecutionListener to manage before and after job listeners within the Fineract project, specifically for COB (Close of Business) processes.

classes.name: COBExecutionListenerRunner
classes.description: A listener runner for COB job execution, managing before and after job listeners based on job name.

methods.name: COBExecutionListenerRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes before and after job listeners for a specific job.

methods.name: beforeJob
methods.description: Invokes all registered before-job listeners before the job starts.

methods.name: afterJob
methods.description: Invokes all registered after-job listeners after the job completes.

methods.name: addAfterListeners
methods.description: Adds after-job listeners matching the specified job name from the application context.

methods.name: addBeforeListeners
methods.description: Adds before-job listeners matching the specified job name from the application context.
